summary: Google DeepMind and India's Atal Innovation Mission launched a pilot of ATL Saathi, a Gemini-powered web application providing teacher mentorship, curriculum content, and project generation for Atal Tinkering Labs across India.

practices.reason: The document mentions a new Gemini model generating project ideas but gives no benchmark or comparative detail an engineering team could act on.
practices.quote: Our latest Gemini 3.5 Flash model instantly generates grade-appropriate, curriculum-aligned project ideas to spark student curiosity and provides educators with step-by-step assembly instructions, wiring diagrams, and safety precautions for unique problem statements brought forward by students.
